sections.heading: Overview
Project goals

sections.content: The respondent will design, deliver and operate an immersive visitor experience within the historic St James Tunnels in Sydney CBD. Services include tour development and delivery, visitor operations, ticketing, marketing and promotion, customer experience management, capital works (as required), development of ancillary products and ongoing growth of the attraction. The operator will be responsible for delivering a safe, high-quality and commercially sustainable visitor experience that celebrates the heritage significance of the site and enhances Sydney's tourism offering.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
In order to gain access to the Request for Tender documents, Tenderers are required to register their interest by sending an email to tss.bidder@transport.nsw.gov.au and include the following information:
1. Tender Title: Unlock St James Tunnels – Engagement of Operator for Visitor Experience
2. RFT ID: WS5759837397
3. Organisation Name
4. ACN/ABN
5. Contract Name
6. Organisation/Contact Postal Address
7. Contact Email Address (Preferably an email address with the contact person's name)
8. Contact Phone number
